translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Worddo haasayaa haasayiyaa boozaappe bare de'uwaan tooshii bayinna hiyyeesaa Asay keeka.
Eri bayinna seelay lo"a gidenna; hamettiidde elleelliyaa uraykka wora bee.
Itti itti Asay bare boozatetsan bare de'uwaa bayzzee; yaatiide k'ay Med'inaa Godaa bolla yilotee.
Duretetsay daro laggetuwaa gujjee; shin hiyyeesatetsay de'iyaa laggetuwaakka duutsee.
Worddo markkay murettenan beenna; wordduwaa haasayiyaawanttukka kessi akkikkino.
Daro Asay mooddiyaa asaa sintsa koyee; c'oo immiyaa uraanna Asay ubbay dabbotee.
Hiyyeesaa asaa Aa ishatuu ubbay is's'iino; hewaappekka aad'uwaa Aa laggetuu aappe haakkiino; I unttuntta awuddashiide kaallinakka, unttunttu Aa gatsi oytsikkino.
Aad'd'eeda eratetsaa demmiyaawe barena siik'ee; akeekaa karihi ootsi oyk'k'iyaawe lo"obaa demmee.
Worddo markkay murettenan attena; wordduwaa haasayiyaawekka d'ayana.
Booza uraw ishalo de'uu bessena; hewaappekka ayilii kaappotuwaa mooddiyaawe iitaa daree.
Aad'd'eeda eratetsay asaw danddayaa immee; bayzzeedda uraw atto giyaawekka bonchchissee.
Kaatiyaa hank'k'uu gaammuwaa guduwaa mala; shin Aa sabay maataa aac'issiya ketterssaa mala.
Booza na'ay bare aawuwaa d'ayissee; walassanchcha machchatakka gollii ubba gede s'okiyaa s'okuwaa mala.
Itti Asay golliyaanne mas'uwaa bare aawuwaappe laattanaw danddayee; shin akeekanchcha machchato Med'inaa Goday immee.
C'oo zolppakkattiyaa uraw gem"ishuu yee; oosuwaa ootsenna Asay koshattee.
Azazuwaa naagiide ootsiyaa asay, bare shemppuwaa naagee; shin sheneko giyaa Asay hayk'k'ee.
Hiyyeesaw keekkiyaa Asay Med'inaa Godaw tal"ee; I he lo"o oosuwaa ac'uwaa c'iggee.
Simmiyaa hidootay de'ishiina, ne naanatuwaa seera; seerana d'ayooppe, neeni unttuntta bayzzaadda.
Hank'k'uwaa suulliyaa Asay bare gatiyaa akko; Aa agga; neeni Aa ashshiyaawaa gidooppe, harattuwaakka neeni Aa hewaadan ootsanawe attena.
Zoriyaa sisa; timirttiyaakka akka. Yaatooppe, neeni wurssetsan aad'd'eeda eranchcha gidanassa.
Asay darobaa halchchee; shin Med'inaa Goday geeddawe polettee.
Asaappe koyettiyaawe aggena siik'uwaa; worddanchcha gidanaappe hiyyeesaa gidiyaawe keeka.
Med'inaa Godaw yayyiyaawe de'oo kaaletsee; aw yayyiyaa Asay kalliide de'ee; iitabaykka Aa bochchenna.
Itti itti Asay daro azalla; wos'iyaan tusheedda sooluwaakka pude baaranaw waayettee.
Neeni k'iliic'iyaawaa shoc'ooppe, akeekay pac'c'eeddawe c'inc'c'atetsaa tamaarana; akeekanchcha asaa neeni seerooppe, I eratetsaa demmana.
Bare aawuwaa bonk'k'iyaa na'ay, bare aatokka sooppe kessiide yederssiyaa na'ay, he na'ay yeellaanne kawushshaa ahiyaa na'aa.
Ta na'aw, neeni zoriyaa sisiyaawaa aggeedawaa gidooppe, eraw zokkiyaa zaaraadda.
Worddo markkay suure pirddaa bolla k'iliic'ee; iita asaa doonay iitatetsaa gujjiide mittee.
K'iliic'iyaawanttoo pirdday, boozatookka wad'ay koshshee.
